LanguageData.CC_Settings_Hint: Defaults. Top: each room type belongs to one lane; use the arrows to move it. Rooms of that type land in that lane unless you move the individual room in the Cleaning tab. Bottom: which filth kinds each work lane cleans.
LanguageData.CC_Tab_Hint: Every enclosed room and every cleaning zone on this map, sorted into lanes. Arrows or right-click move an entry to another lane; left-click jumps to it. Draw new zones with Architect > Zone > Cleaning zone.
LanguageData.CC_Tab_DefaultsTip: Open the mod settings: which lane each room type lands in by default, and which filth kinds each lane cleans.
LanguageData.CC_Tab_ZoneTip: Cleaning zone. Its lane applies wherever it is drawn, even outside the home area. Delete it from its own buttons or the right-click menu.
LanguageData.CC_Tab_PinnedYes: Pinned to this lane (*). Right-click and pick Automatic to unpin.
LanguageData.CC_Tab_PinnedNo: Placed automatically by room type (default lane: {0}).
LanguageData.CC_Custom_PriorityCommandDesc: Which Work tab column cleans this entry: high uses the "mop" column, normal the "sweep" column, low the vanilla "clean" column. Set colonists' priorities for those columns in the Work tab.
LanguageData.CC_Custom_CutPlantsDesc: Wild grass and bushes here are marked for cutting (trees and crops are left alone). Done by the Plant cut work column.
LanguageData.CC_Custom_ClearSnowDesc: These cells are added to the snow/sand clear area while this is on, and removed again when it is turned off.
LanguageData.CC_Custom_HaulDebrisDesc: Rock chunks, slag and other things that are not hauled on their own are marked for hauling. Needs a stockpile that accepts them.
LanguageData.CC_CleaningZoneDesc: Draw a cleaning zone. Filth on its cells follows the zone's lane in the Cleaning tab, even outside the home area. New zones start in the Custom lane.
LanguageData.CC_Zone_LaneCommandDesc: Which lane of the Cleaning tab this zone belongs to.
